counter_evidence.text: In the sampled failing PlaceOrder trace, every non-payment child call succeeded: checkout's oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (rpc.grpc.status_code=0), three oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (0), two oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (0), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (0), with server-side spans in cart (POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart), currency (Currency/Convert, otel.status_code=OK), product-catalog (rpc.grpc.status_code=0), shipping (rpc.grpc.status_code=0, POST 200) and quote (POST /getquote, calculate-quote) all without error status. A single sampled trace cannot prove every such call succeeded.

The checkout rollout is a weak explanation for an immediate code defect: the replacement pod carries the same image digest as the pod it replaced (configuration-only change per image_id), and PlaceOrder ran with 0 error rate and ~0.0167-0.0209/s UNSET spans for roughly nine minutes after the new pod was ready at 17:00:25Z, with the first observed charge failures only at ~17:09:44Z-17:10:26Z; the failure text itself is thrown inside payment's charge.js, not in checkout.

fact.text: Alert condition reproduced from the alert's own expression inputs: checkout server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (service_name=checkout, span_kind=SPAN_KIND_SERVER, namespace otel-demo) had STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET ~0.0167-0.0209/s for every 5-minute evaluation through 17:09:44Z, then ERROR 0.005996/s at 17:10:44Z, 0.009329/s at 17:11:44Z, 0.008442/s at 17:12:44Z and 0.007998/s at 17:13:44Z while UNSET fell to 0 from 17:11:44Z, i.e. an error ratio of ~1.0, above the 0.5 threshold. Span counts are not unique request counts.

The failing hop is inside PlaceOrder's payment call, one-to-one: in the checkout span breakdown, span_name oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span_kind SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, STATUS_CODE_ERROR) has exactly the same rate values at every evaluation point as server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.00599561111111111 at 17:10:44Z, 0.009328944444444445 at 17:11:44Z, 0.008441518518518518 at 17:12:44Z, 0.007997838879884221 at 17:13:44Z), while checkout's other client spans (CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, ShippingService/GetQuote, ShippingService/ShipOrder) show no ERROR series at all in the hour.

The error text originates in the payment service: its own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment, service_version 2.0.2) is status_state recorded with error=true, grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and the stacktrace is 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'. Its only visible child is an internal span 'charge' (589us, no status recorded) and no downstream payment dependency span is visible in this sample.

The same sampled trace (trace_id 0a08be933bfc73b30856aae8c24608df, first error at 17:10:26Z) shows the propagation through supplied parent references: payment Charge server span 40cbb5c81189e3fa <- checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span 3518524dfa429274 (error, rpc.grpc.status_code=2, status description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold') <- checkout server oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span 023c96fdfca72e1d (error, rpc.grpc.status_code=13, 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold') <- frontend client grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span 69f732fc7b3c450d (error, code 13) <- frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' <- frontend 'POST /api/checkout' <- frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' and 'ingress' (http.status_code 500). The ingress span's own parent is not visible, so the edge above it is unknown.

Payment's own view matches a total failure of charging: for server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service_name=payment), STATUS_CODE_ERROR went from 0 to 0.004185/s at 17:09:44Z (while STATUS_CODE_UNSET was still 0.016742/s), then 0.008352/s at 17:11:44Z with UNSET 0; the app_payment_transactions_total rate fell from ~0.0167/s to 0 from 17:11:44Z onward.

Payment was not redeployed or rescheduled in the incident window: its only ReplicaSets are payment-6f7bc865d6 (created 1791282782) and payment-7bd449ddbf (created 1791281078), no new payment ReplicaSet appears during the last hour; deployment payment kube_deployment_status_replicas stayed 1 and Available/Progressing true the whole 16:43:44Z-17:13:44Z window; pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv has kube_pod_container_state_started 1791640744 (about 2026-10-10T13:59Z, ~14 days before the window) and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87. Its kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total reads 11 cumulative, with restart timing not resolvable from a cumulative counter.

The checkpoint rollout named in the operator note is visible in cluster state but as a same-image replacement: ReplicaSet checkout-75c8bcd746 was created at 1792861224 (2026-10-24T17:00:24Z), its pod checkout-75c8bcd746-4m5rz started/container-ready at 1792861225 (17:00:25Z), and it runs the identical image digest ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635 as the previous pod checkout-64dfcb4cc8-qc7wr. The old pod's series end at 1792861244 (17:00:44Z); checkout deployment status stayed replicas=1, Available=true, Progressing=true, and both pods show 0 container restarts.

Payment began emitting flagd flag-evaluation client spans exactly when its failures began: for service_name=payment, span_name 'grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat' (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, STATUS_CODE_UNSET) is 0 for every evaluation from 16:53:44Z through 17:08:44Z, becomes 0.016666/s (2-minute rate) at 17:09:44Z and returns to 0 afterwards; the flagd side shows 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat' at the same 17:09:44Z point plus a 'ResolveInt' burst at 17:08:44Z (0.4877/s) and 17:09:44Z (0.1333/s). No flag-evaluation spans are attributed to checkout in the hour.

Payment was operating normally immediately before the onset: the ERROR rate of payment's Charge server span is 0 for all evaluations from 16:53:44Z to 17:08:44Z (UNSET ~0.0125-0.0249/s), and checkout PlaceOrder ERROR is 0 with UNSET ~0.0167-0.0209/s up to the 5-minute window ending 17:09:44Z, so the same service/span had a zero-error baseline earlier in the authorized hour.

Impact observed at callers of checkout, each with its own error spans: frontend server span 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (STATUS_CODE_ERROR) first appears at the 5-minute window ending 17:09:44Z (0.004185/s) and rises to 0.008352/s at 17:11:44Z; frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and frontend 'POST' carry http.status_code=500 in the sampled trace; frontend-proxy spans 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' show http.status_code 500 and ERROR status. These are the sampled/aggregated spans of those services only, not a count of all affected requests.

Observed but not tied to this onset: ERROR spans on ad and recommendation for span_name 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (about 0.0042/s) occur intermittently before the payment failures (17:04:44Z-17:10:44Z) and again at 17:13:44Z, and cart's 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean' activity occurs at 17:05:44Z-17:06:44Z; cart, product-catalog and checkout non-payment spans show no ERROR in that scan.

Checkout's PlaceOrder and payment's Charge span rates fell at the same time as the failures: PlaceOrder total rate (ERROR+UNSET) was ~0.0208/s up to 17:09:44Z and 0.008352/s at 17:11:44Z, and checkout's CartService/EmptyCart, ShippingService/ShipOrder and HTTP POST client span rates fell to 0 by 17:11:44Z-17:12:44Z. The cause of the lower span rate (for example load-generator or retry behaviour) was not examined and is unknown.

Historical comparability of the status label is limited: over the prior 24 hours the same series show PlaceOrder and payment Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.02-0.05/s until about 09:18:44Z with UNSET 0, then UNSET nonzero and ERROR ~0 afterwards, so only the in-hour baseline (ERROR exactly 0 until the 17:09:44Z evaluation) is used as the comparable baseline for this incident.

hypothesis.text: Leading candidate for the deepest cause: payment's charge path began honouring a runtime flag/config-driven failure condition at ~17:09-17:10Z, causing it to throw 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' from charge.js:37. Support: payment's first flagd ResolveFloat client spans of the hour appear in the same minute the failures start, the error is thrown locally in payment with no failing payment dependency and a very fast 1931us server span / 589us internal span, and payment's pod, ReplicaSet and image did not change. Unconfirmed: the flag identity and value, and what changed the configuration.

Competing candidate that cannot be excluded: release rel-20261024170023 (checkout ReplicaSet checkout-75c8bcd746 at 17:00:24Z) changed checkout's configuration or request content such that payment rejects charges as an invalid token, making checkout's rollout the trigger even though the same image digest was used. It is disfavoured by the nine-minute error-free interval after the new pod was ready and by the error being generated inside payment, but the deployment's environment/config diff is not observable in this Run.

report.summary: The alert is a real, trace-confirmed failure chain, not a telemetry artefact: checkout server spans of oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder switched from STATUS_CODE_UNSET to STATUS_CODE_ERROR at ~17:09:44Z-17:10:44Z, reaching a ~1.0 error ratio (0.00933/s ERROR vs 0 UNSET at 17:11:44Z), and the failing hop is the checkout client call to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge. The payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fails with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13, carries forward as gRPC 13 INTERNAL at checkout PlaceOrder and as HTTP 500 at frontend and frontend-proxy. Payment shows 100% Charge failures and its app_payment_transactions_total rate falls to 0 after ~17:11:44Z. Checkout's other PlaceOrder dependencies succeeded in the sampled failing trace. Two candidate triggers remain: (leading) a runtime flag/config-driven change inside payment, evidenced by payment emitting its first flagd ResolveFloat client spans in the same minute the errors began while its pod/ReplicaSet/image were unchanged; and (disfavoured) the checkout rollout rel-20261024170023 at 17:00:24Z, which used the identical image digest as the pod it replaced and was followed by ~9 minutes of error-free PlaceOrder traffic. The exact flag value or configuration content could not be observed because flag config, change history and pod logs are not integrated.
